Post Date: 2020-10-07T13:59:03Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Cross multiplication on JAX is faster in CPU compared to GPU
Description: I tried taking the cross product of two (10,000 * 10,000) matrics on NumPy, TensorFlow and Jax to compare the time it takes to complete the operation.
On CPU:
Numpy took **58.32** seconds
TensorFlow took **64.802** seconds
Jax took **0.034** seconds

On GPU:
Numpy took **59.04** seconds (understandable because NumPy doesn't use GPU or TPU acceleration)
TensorFlow took **0.197** seconds
Jax took **2.02** seconds

Why is Jax slower on GPU(2.02 seconds) as compared to CPU(0.034 seconds)?
